title: Hollyland: first contact
subject: Paid collaboration opportunity
body:
Hi Maya,

I love watching your unboxing videos. "My 2026 desk setup tour" and "Unboxing the Retro Mini console" stood out to us, especially your deep dive, and the passion you bring to each video really shows.

I'm Brandi, part of the Creator Partnerships team at Hollyland, a global brand making wireless audio and video gear for creators.

We'd like to partner with you on a short, 60-second integration featuring one of our products. We'll send the device and pay your usual rate, and if this first collaboration works out, we'd like to make it a long-term partnership.

Is that something you'd be up for?

Best,
Brandi
Hollyland
Creator Partnerships

title: Hollyland: follow-up with link
subject: Re: Paid collaboration opportunity
body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for getting back to me so fast, and for spelling out your rates. We'll take your cross-platform option: US$300 for one 60-second integration, and the device is yours to keep at no cost.

We manage the campaign through Matchy, a secure dashboard that handles channel verification, the brief, picking your device, confirming the deal and the payment. Your US$300 is held for you once your channel stats are connected in Matchy.

Here's the Hollyland campaign:
https://joinmatchy.com/hollyland

1. Paste your YouTube channel link and click "Analyze My Channel".
2. Verify that the channel is yours, confirm the rate, and reserve your payment.

Best,
Brandi

title: Creoventura: AndaSeat deal
subject: AndaSeat x Maya Makes: paid collaboration details
body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for your interest. Creoventura is the influencer management agency running AndaSeat's creator campaign, and we'll handle your collaboration from here.

Here are the details:
- Brand: AndaSeat
- Collaboration: paid
- Deliverable: one 60-second integration in a YouTube video
- Fee: US$500
- Timeline: video live within 14 days of confirmation

To take part, open your personal campaign page and verify your channel:
https://creoventura.com/campaign/maya-makes

Best regards,
Creoventura Support Team
